lines.name: Market Line
lines.beyond: both ends leave the sheet: south on Sunset Way past y -780 and north on Harbour Road past y 320. The termini and depot are off-sheet (assumed; no source says so).

notes: What changed: I redrew T2's two R50 bends to fix the T-C1 fault. Last round I put the bends 6 m in from the road edge. That was wrong: on an R50 quarter arc the inner track (r 48.2) cuts the inner corner of the junction unless that corner lies within 48.2 m of the arc centre. I checked this by hand. I have not run the checker: run bun tools/plan/cli.ts and confirm exit 0 before accepting.

West bend: the path runs at x -349.5 and z -403.5, so the outer track sits at x -351.3 and z -401.7, inside Sunset Way (x -352 to -328) and Market Street (z -419 to -401). The arc centre is (-299.5,-453.5). The inner plot corner is (-328,-419), 44.7 m from the centre, inside the inner track's 48.2 m. Margin is 3.5 m on the inner track and 0.6 to 0.7 m at the outer kerbs.

East bend: the path runs at x 309.5 and z -416.5, so the outer track sits at x 311.3 and z -418.3, inside Harbour Road (x 288 to 312) and Market Street. The arc centre is (259.5,-366.5) and the inner corner (288,-401) is 44.7 m away. The margins are the same as the west bend.

No single straight line along Market Street can serve both bends. The west bend needs the line at z -407.9 or further north, and the east bend needs z -412.1 or further south. So T2 shifts 13 m across the street between x -170 and x -80, with r 200 fillets (about 8° each, tangents about 14 m). That stretch stays inside Market Street's 18 m width, across the median, clear of the suggested stop sites and of both R50 tangents.

Unchanged from last round: T1 and S1. T2 crosses T1 at grade at (0,-416.5) in the Boulevard junction. Interchange distances: a T2 stop near (40,-416.5) is about 54 m from T1 Records (0,-380), and one near (309.5,-30) is about 43 m from S1 Harbour (340,0). Both are within 150 m. Reach to the four stop sites I suggested last round is unchanged to within a few metres.

Still open for Aster to take to Sky: the off-sheet continuations for T2 are my assumption; whether T1 ends at the circus; whether the Sphere and harbour loops from tide's draft are retired; and the circus road/island mismatch, which I will fix when I next edit the roads. The Sky Loop stays rejected on S-C1, because it would run over corner plots.
